subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.

The meal is being prepared by the chef.

options.text: The chef is preparing the meal.
The chef will prepare the meal.
The chef did prepare the meal.
The chef was preparing the meal.

solution:
The correct answer is '**The chef is preparing the meal**.'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• The given sentence is in the Present Continuous Tense and in Active voice.
 
• The rule for changing a sentence in Present Continuous Tense from Passive voice to Active voice:
 
 
• ​Interchange the object and the subject with each other, i.e. Object of the passive sentence becomes the subject of the active sentence.
 
• The helping verb comes before the object in the passive voice as the passive voice starts with the object of the active voice.
 
• Convert the verb into present/base form or 1st form of the verb.
 
• Structure: Subject + is/am/are + V1 + ing + Object (Active voice)
 
 

​ Object + is/am/are/ + being + V3 + by + Subject (Passive voice)

 
• Solution: *The meal is being prepared by the chef. (Passive Voice)*

*​ The chef is preparing the meal. (Active Voice)*
